servers.display_name: Has the shared value as its id
Has the shared value as its path

notes: Same decode site again (AppConfig.init(from:) line 744-746). Here the first server's id is the literal string that the second server uses as its server_dir. Since AppConfig performs no cross-field or cross-entry reconciliation on `servers` at all, both entries decode with their own id/server_dir kept exactly as given -- there is no code path that could confuse one server's id for another's path, because nothing compares them.
